ayahs.translation: By those who range themselves in rows;
by those who reprove severely,
and those who recite the Exhortation;
surely your God is One,

ayahs.arabicText: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا وَ رَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِؕ
ayahs.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two, the Lord of the Easts.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا زَیَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنْیَا بِزِیْنَةِ اِ۟لْكَوَاكِبِۙ
ayahs.translation: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars

ayahs.arabicText: وَ حِفْظًا مِّنْ كُلِّ شَیْطٰنٍ مَّارِدٍۚ
ayahs.translation: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَسَّمَّعُوْنَ اِلَى الْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰى وَ یُقْذَفُوْنَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍۗۖ
ayahs.translation: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side
and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَاَتْبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
ayahs.translation: And if any is able to snatch a fragment, he is pursued by a piercing flame.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ اَهُمْ اَشَدُّ خَلْقًا اَمْ مَّنْ خَلَقْنَا١ؕ اِنَّا خَلَقْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ طِیْنٍ لَّازِبٍ
ayahs.translation: So ask them (that is, human beings): “Were they harder to create than the objects We created?” We created them from sticky clay.
You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it,
and when they are admonished, they pay no heed;
and if they see any Sign, they laugh it away

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْۤا اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌۚۖ
ayahs.translation: and say: “This is nothing but plain sorcery.

ayahs.arabicText: ءَاِذَا مِتْنَا وَ كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّ عِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبْعُوْثُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones, we will be raised to life?
And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?”
Tell them: “Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنَّمَا هِیَ زَجْرَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ فَاِذَا هُمْ یَنْظُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo, they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا یٰوَیْلَنَا هٰذَا یَوْمُ الدِّیْنِ
ayahs.translation: They will then say: “Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.”

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا یَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِیْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: “Yes, this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.”

ayahs.arabicText: اُحْشُرُوا الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا وَ اَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَ مَا كَانُوْا یَعْبُدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (Then will the command be given): “Muster all the wrong-doers and their spouses and the deities whom they used to serve

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ فَاهْدُوْهُمْ اِلٰى صِرَاطِ الْجَحِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: apart from Allah, and direct them to the path of Hell,
and detain them there; they will be called to account.
How is it that you are not helping one another?
Indeed, today they are surrendering themselves completely.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ یَّتَسَآءَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَاْتُوْنَنَا عَنِ الْیَمِیْنِ
ayahs.translation: (The followers will say to their leaders): “You used to come to us from the right hand.”
They will say: “Nay, you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَیْكُمْ مِّنْ سُلْطٰنٍ١ۚ بَلْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا طٰغِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people,

ayahs.arabicText: فَحَقَّ عَلَیْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَاۤ١ۖۗ اِنَّا لَذَآئِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.
So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.”
On that Day, they will all share the chastisement.
Thus do We treat the culprits.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا اِذَا قِیْلَ لَهُمْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ١ۙ یَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Whenever it was said to them: “There is no true deity apart from Allah,” they waxed proud

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ اَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوْۤا اٰلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُوْنٍؕ
ayahs.translation: and said: “Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?”

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ جَآءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ صَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.
(They will be told): “You shall taste the grievous chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.”
But Allah's chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).
For them awaits a known provision,
a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured
in the Gardens of Bliss.
They will be seated upon couches set face to face;
a cup filled with wine from its springs, will be passed around to them;
white, sparkling (wine), a delight to the drinkers.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا فِیْهَا غَوْلٌ وَّ لَا هُمْ عَنْهَا یُنْزَفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.
Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens with bashful, restrained glances,
so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg's shell.
Then some of them will turn to others, and will ask each other.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ اِنِّیْ كَانَ لِیْ قَرِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: One of them will say: “I had a companion in the world
who used to say: -- Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?

ayahs.arabicText: ءَاِذَا مِتْنَا وَ كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّ عِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَدِیْنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?'
He will say: -- Do you wish to know where he is now?'
Then he will look downwards, and will see him in the depths of Hell.
He will say to him: -- By Allah, you almost ruined me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ لَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّیْ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But for Allah's favour, I should be one of those who have been mustered here.
So, are we not going to die,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْاُوْلٰى وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?'”
Surely this is the supreme triumph.
For the like of it should the workers work.

ayahs.arabicText: اَذٰلِكَ خَیْرٌ نُّزُلًا اَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّوْمِ
ayahs.translation: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?
We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِیْۤ اَصْلِ الْجَحِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.
Its spathes are like the heads of satans.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنَّهُمْ لَاٰكِلُوْنَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُوْنَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it, filling their bellies with it.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَیْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِیْمٍۚ
ayahs.translation: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.
Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.
These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error,
and they are running in their footsteps.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ اَكْثَرُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred,
and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.
Observe, then, what was the end of those that had been warned,
except for the chosen servants of Allah?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ نَادٰىنَا نُوْحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِیْبُوْنَ٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: Noah had called upon Us (earlier). See, how excellent We were in answering him!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَجَّیْنٰهُ وَ اَهْلَهٗ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِیْمِ٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;
and made his offspring the only ones to survive,
and We established for him a good name among posterity.
Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.
Thus do We reward all those who do good.
Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.
Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.
Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).
When he came to his Lord with a pure heart,

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِیْهِ وَ قَوْمِهٖ مَا ذَا تَعْبُدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and said to his father and his people: “Whom do you worship?
Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?
What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?”
Then he looked carefully at the stars
and said: “I am sick.”
So turning their backs, they went away from him.

ayahs.arabicText: فَرَاغَ اِلٰۤى اٰلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ اَلَا تَاْكُلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said: “What is the matter with you, why do you not eat?
What is the matter with you, why do you not speak?”
Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand,
whereupon people came to him running.
Abraham said to them: “Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اللّٰهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَ مَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوا ابْنُوْا لَهٗ بُنْیَانًا فَاَلْقُوْهُ فِی الْجَحِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: They spoke among themselves: “Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.”
They had contrived an evil plan against him, but We abased them all.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ اِنِّیْ ذَاهِبٌ اِلٰى رَبِّیْ سَیَهْدِیْنِ
ayahs.translation: Abraham said: “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.
Lord, grant me a righteous son.”
(In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْیَ قَالَ یٰبُنَیَّ اِنِّیْۤ اَرٰى فِی الْمَنَامِ اَنِّیْۤ اَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَا ذَا تَرٰى١ؕ قَالَ یٰۤاَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ١٘ سَتَجِدُنِیْۤ اِنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and when he was old enough to go about and work with him, (one day) Abraham said to him: “My son, I see in my dream that I am slaughtering you. So consider (and tell me) what you think.” He said: “Do as you are bidden. You will find me, if Allah so wills, among the steadfast.”
When both surrendered (to Allah's command) and Abraham flung the son down on his forehead,
We cried out: “O Abraham,

ayahs.arabicText: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّءْیَا١ۚ اِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِی الْمُحْسِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: you have indeed fulfilled your dream. Thus do We reward the good-doers.”
This was indeed a plain trial.
And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice,
and We preserved for him a good name among posterity.
Peace be upon Abraham.
Thus do We reward the good-doers.
Surely he was one of Our believing servants.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ بَشَّرْنٰهُ بِاِسْحٰقَ نَبِیًّا مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We gave him the good news of Isaac, a Prophet and among the righteous ones.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ بٰرَكْنَا عَلَیْهِ وَ عَلٰۤى اِسْحٰقَ١ؕ وَ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَّ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهٖ مُبِیْنٌ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among the offspring of the two some did good and some plainly wronged themselves.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلٰى مُوْسٰى وَ هٰرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Verily We bestowed Our favours on Moses and Aaron

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَجَّیْنٰهُمَا وَ قَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِیْمِۚ
ayahs.translation: and We delivered both of them and their people from the great calamity.
We succoured them, and they gained the upper hand (against their enemies).
We granted them a Clear Book,
and showed them the Straight Way,
and preserved for them a good name among posterity.
Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
Thus do We reward the good-doers.
Surely both of them were among Our believing servants.
Surely, Elias too was among the Messengers.
(Call to mind) when he said to his people: “Will you not fear Allah?

ayahs.arabicText: اَتَدْعُوْنَ بَعْلًا وَّ تَذَرُوْنَ اَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Do you call upon Baal and forsake the Best of the Creators?

ayahs.arabicText: اللّٰهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَ رَبَّ اٰبَآئِكُمُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of yore.”
But they denounced him as a liar, so they will surely be arraigned (for punishment),
except Allah's chosen servants.
We preserved a good name for him among posterity.
Peace be upon Elias.
Thus do We reward the good-doers.
He was one of Our believing servants.
And Lot too was one of the Messengers.
(Call to mind) when We delivered him and all his kinsfolk,
except for an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.
Then We utterly destroyed the rest of them.
You pass by their desolate habitations in the morning
and at night. Do you still not understand?
And Jonah too was one of the Messengers.
Call to mind when he fled to the laden ship,
cast lots, and was among the losers.
Then a fish swallowed him, and he was blameworthy.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَوْ لَاۤ اَنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah,

ayahs.arabicText: لَلَبِثَ فِیْ بَطْنِهٖۤ اِلٰى یَوْمِ یُبْعَثُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.
But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْۢبَتْنَا عَلَیْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّنْ یَّقْطِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: and caused a gourd tree to grow over him,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَرْسَلْنٰهُ اِلٰى مِائَةِ اَلْفٍ اَوْ یَزِیْدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more,
and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ اَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَ لَهُمُ الْبَنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: So ask their opinion: “(Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلٰٓئِكَةَ اِنَاثًا وَّ هُمْ شٰهِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?”
Behold, it is one of their fabrications that they say:
“Allah has begotten.” They are liars!
Did He choose daughters rather than sons?
What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?
Will you then not take heed?
Do you have any clear authority for such claims?
Bring your Book, if you are truthful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلُوْا بَیْنَهٗ وَ بَیْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا١ؕ وَ لَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ اِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels; and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).
(They say): “Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him,
all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.
So you and your deities
shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah
except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا مِنَّاۤ اِلَّا لَهٗ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُوْمٌۙ
ayahs.translation: As for us, there is none but has an appointed station.
Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)
and we are of those who glorify Allah.”
They used to say before:

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ اَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: “If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore
we would surely have been Allah's chosen servants.”
But when it came to them, they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers
that they shall certainly be succoured,
and that Our hosts shall triumph.
So, (O Prophet), leave them alone for a while,
and see, and soon they too shall see.
Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard, evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.
Leave them alone for a while,
and see; and they too shall soon see.

ayahs.arabicText: سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا یَصِفُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, above what they attribute to Him,
and peace be upon the Messengers,
and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe.
